help.welcome: Welcome to Help and Support Center
help.pickTopic: Pick a Help topic on the left.
tips: You can press the Windows key and R to open the Run box.
Alt+Tab switches between open windows. Hold Alt and keep tapping Tab.
Ctrl+Escape opens the Start menu. Escape closes it.
Typing calc, notepad or charmap in the Run box opens the program.
Files deleted from My Computer wait in the Recycle Bin until it is emptied.
The screen saver starts after the wait set in Display Properties.
Win+L locks the workstation; the welcome screen lists the party.
The Event Viewer writes down everything the machine does.
Booted from the Hyperdeck, the machine's parts are the ones fitted to the board.
Disk Defragmenter's coloured blocks were the closest thing to a game on most office machines.

tour.title: Take a tour of Archways XP
body: Archways XP is the operating system of the Hyperdeck and of every beige desktop of 2001 the party sits at.
The Start menu holds every program, filed by heading. The right column has the places you visit most.
Programs open in windows; the taskbar shows each open window, and the tray shows what the machine is up to.

run.title: The Run box
body: Press Win+R, or click Run... in the Start menu, and type the name of a program: calc, notepad, charmap, regedit, msconfig, cmd, control, winver, cleanmgr, defrag, sysdm.cpl, timedate.cpl, intl.cpl, mmsys.cpl, appwiz.cpl, desk.cpl, devmgmt.msc, eventvwr, osk, wscui.cpl.
The command prompt runs the same names: typing calc at the prompt opens the Calculator.

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
body: Alt+Tab switches windows. Alt+F4 closes the active one, or turns the machine off when none is open.
Ctrl+Esc opens the Start menu. Ctrl+Shift+Esc and Ctrl+Alt+Del open the Task Manager.
Win+D shows the desktop, Win+M minimizes everything, Win+E opens My Computer, Win+F searches, Win+L locks, Win+Pause opens System Properties.
F1 opens this window, F3 the Search Companion, PrintScreen copies the screen to the ClipBook.

hardware.title: The machine you are sitting at
body: When the Hyperdeck boots the desktop, the parts fitted to its board are the hardware: memory, processor, adapter, disk, modem and sound card are read off the deck, and System Properties, Device Manager and the Control Panel all agree.
Reached from anywhere else, the desktop runs on a stock machine of 2001, rolled once per world and kept.

recycle.title: The Recycle Bin
body: A file deleted from My Computer goes to the Recycle Bin, where it keeps the folder it came from. Restore it, delete it for good, or empty the bin.
The command prompt's DEL is a real delete, as it always was.

security.title: Security Center
body: The balloon that says your computer might be at risk comes from Security Center. Its three switches (firewall, updates, virus protection) are all off on a fresh install.
Turn them on and the balloon stops. Nothing else changes, which is how it was.

saver.title: Screen savers
body: Display Properties picks the screen saver and its wait. Starfield, Mystify, Marquee, Beziers and Flat Pipes are there.
Any key or click ends it.

power.title: Turning off
body: Turn Off offers Stand By, Turn Off and Restart. Stand By dims the panel until a key is pressed. Restart brings the desktop back up.
Log Off offers Switch User: the party members are the accounts on this machine.
